title: Security Events, Analytics & False-Positive Feedback Queue

invariants_enforced: Strict DDD architectural boundaries (0 forbidden imports in domain layers)
Critical ML Safety Rule: False-Positive feedback enters human review queue; zero auto-retraining or live threshold mutation
Defensive domain payload scrubbing (automatic redaction of Authorization, Cookie, passwords, tokens)
Internal gateway key validation (X-WAF-Ingest-Key required, 401 Unauthorized if missing/invalid)
Strict RBAC hierarchy (OWNER/ADMIN review feedback, ANALYST submits feedback, VIEWER read-only)
Cross-tenant isolation (all analytics and event queries strictly tenant-scoped, cross-tenant yields 404)
Pure statistical analytics aggregation (p50, p95, time-series bucketing, top threat ranking)
